independent_vcs_hammer.note_on_population: One additional legal pair was deliberately stalled and flushed by synchronous reset, so issued_pairs is accepted_legal_pairs minus one.

numeric_and_parameter_audit.m195_specific_requirement: The integrated producer must prove each per-window bank count is bounded by the actual stage geometry and must prevent decrement underflow; the standalone selector cannot establish either invariant.

area_proxy_audit.reason: The sum omits two descriptor buffers, head/count mutation, token-boundary/odd-tail release, SRAM request/response tags, return alignment and commit control. It also assumes exact replay opportunity becomes finite wall-cycle throughput without fill, drain or memory stalls.

p0_before_integrated_admission.finding: M194 consumes already-materialized counts and heads; it contains no queue storage, atomic selected-head advancement, per-window empty detection, dual-buffer ownership or release. Therefore it is necessary steering but not a complete implementation of the M195 token-owned pair policy.
p0_before_integrated_admission.required_closure: Build a finite two-window token-owned descriptor frontend. On issue_accept, decrement exactly the selected nonempty head per bank; release a window only after all of its banks drain and all associated returned work commits; implement odd-tail and token-boundary flush without reordering.

p0_before_integrated_admission.finding: There is no weight-SRAM request/response interface, response tag, epoch or stale-response quarantine. issue_pair_last is request-time metadata and is not sufficient to authorize buffer or token release across variable memory latency.
p0_before_integrated_admission.required_closure: Add bank/window/token/epoch tags through the response pipeline; prove at most one request per physical bank per cycle, exact response conservation and that reset/flush invalidates stale returns before Acc24 or buffer release.

p0_before_integrated_admission.finding: The selector proves same-token admission at request time but does not prove that both windows' returned products update one and only one Acc24 context, nor that final commit happens once after all banks/windows drain.
p0_before_integrated_admission.required_closure: Integrate the fixed-bank accumulator and commit path with token ownership, response-aligned last semantics, single final commit and no update after release.

p0_before_integrated_admission.finding: The 1.092758696 throughput/area value is an additive selector-only proxy, not measured integrated density, and the 1.108968500 factor is exact replay arithmetic rather than finite wall-cycle RTL speed.
p0_before_integrated_admission.required_closure: Run an exact-payload, finite-fill integrated VCS A/B against a matched W1 frontend and matched 3 ns DC including every added/removed control register and queue; admit density only if both functional conservation and matched area/timing pass.

p1_hardening.finding: The DC contract claim_boundary.selector_logic_only_dc is false even though the sealed run is explicitly a selector logic-only DC measurement. This is internally inconsistent.
p1_hardening.required_closure: Correct the admission overlay or successor contract while leaving sealed evidence immutable.

p1_hardening.finding: The milestone SVA checks handshakes, nonempty outputs, token equality, stall stability and channel identity, but it does not directly assert window-0 priority, window-1 fallthrough, source-count equality at acceptance-to-output, or pair_last equivalence to every merged depth <= 1.
p1_hardening.required_closure: Add acceptance-to-output semantic assertions in the integrated block; retain an independent scoreboard.

p1_hardening.finding: cp_bad_channel_attack is actually a generic pair_valid && protocol_error cover, so the SVA coverage report does not distinguish bad-channel, empty and inactive-window-count attacks. The milestone TB does test all four procedurally.
p1_hardening.required_closure: Use four predicate-specific fail-close covers/assertions in the successor.

p1_hardening.finding: A new illegal request closes future input but leaves an already-buffered legal issue able to drain. This can be a sound policy, but the contract does not explicitly state or test illegal-request-during-stall behavior.
p1_hardening.required_closure: Specify drain-versus-kill semantics and test an attack while a legal output is stalled.

admitted: Per-bank oldest-nonempty/fallthrough steering is independently functionally validated.
The standalone registered selector meets the stated 3 ns pre-macro logic-only DC screen.
The standalone selector has no discovered COUNT_BITS overflow for 8-bit counts; 255+255 was exercised independently.
not_admitted: Complete M195 token-owned pair fusion RTL
Queue/head advancement or dual-buffer release correctness
SRAM return correctness, stale-response safety or reset epoch safety
Physical, FFN, network or system speedup
